annotations.title: Validate and format a phone number

description: Validates a phone number using Google's libphonenumber rules and returns it in E.164 (+14155552671), international and national formats, plus the country and line type (mobile, fixed line, toll free...). For numbers without a +country code, pass default_country.

default_country.description: Two-letter country code used when the number has no "+" prefix, e.g. "US", "GB", "DE"

name: validate_phone
title: Validate and format a phone number
